name: Shrinkwrap Modifier
description: Shrink wrapping modifier to shrink wrap and object to a target

items.name: Nearest Surface Point
items.description: Shrink the mesh to the nearest target surface

items.name: Project
items.description: Shrink the mesh to the nearest target surface along a given axis

items.name: Nearest Vertex
items.description: Shrink the mesh to the nearest target vertex

items.name: Target Normal Project
items.description: Shrink the mesh to the nearest target surface along the interpolated vertex normals of the target

props.name: Snap Mode
props.description: Select how vertices are constrained to the target surface

items.name: On Surface
items.description: The point is constrained to the surface of the target object, with distance offset towards the original point location

items.name: Inside
items.description: The point is constrained to be inside the target object

items.name: Outside
items.description: The point is constrained to be outside the target object

items.name: Outside Surface
items.description: The point is constrained to the surface of the target object, with distance offset always to the outside, towards or away from the original location

items.name: Above Surface
items.description: The point is constrained to the surface of the target object, with distance offset applied exactly along the target normal

props.name: Face Cull
props.description: Stop vertices from projecting to a face on the target when facing towards/away

items.name: Front
items.description: No projection when in front of the face

items.name: Back
items.description: No projection when behind the face

props.name: Auxiliary Target
props.description: Additional mesh target to shrink to

props.name: Offset
props.description: Distance to keep from the target

props.name: Project Limit
props.description: Limit the distance used for projection (zero disables)

props.name: Subdivision Levels
props.description: Number of subdivisions that must be performed before extracting vertices' positions and normals

props.name: Negative
props.description: Allow vertices to move in the negative direction of axis

props.name: Positive
props.description: Allow vertices to move in the positive direction of axis

props.name: Invert Cull
props.description: When projecting in the negative direction invert the face cull mode
